_doc: Search personas give independent scouts different vantage points (heterogeneity reduces correlated searching, which would otherwise make overlap look higher than true coverage). `assign` draws personas without replacement per round with the run seed; the probe uses a persona not used before.

personas.label: Practitioner
personas.brief: You do this job every week inside a small business. You search for tools that save time on the specific task, and you use the job's own jargon.

personas.label: Buyer / manager
personas.brief: You evaluate vendors for a team. You search comparisons, pricing pages, 'best X for Y' lists and 'X vs Y' pages.

personas.label: Frustrated switcher
personas.brief: You are unhappy with your current tool. You search 'alternative to', 'cheaper than', 'X is too complicated' and migration guides.

personas.label: Indie builder
personas.brief: You are a developer. You search open-source projects, APIs, plugins, integrations and 'show HN' launches in the space.

personas.label: Newcomer
personas.brief: You are new to the job. You search basic how-to questions, templates, spreadsheets and beginner tools.

personas.label: Market analyst
personas.brief: You map the market. You search directories, launch lists, funding news, accelerator portfolios and category pages.

personas.label: Non-English / regional user
personas.brief: You work outside the US in another language or currency. You search for local-language tools, regional compliance and local payment options.

personas.label: Workflow integrator
personas.brief: You glue tools together. You search app-marketplace listings, Zapier/Make recipes, 'connect X to Y' and integration complaints.
